correctness.rationale: For binary projective square-free degree-two evaluation, removing exactly the singleton zero columns yields matrix rows indexed by pairs e⊂[m+1] and columns c_S recording all pair edges of each |S|≥2. All columns are nonzero and distinct, so the dual has no weights one or two. A relation among t=3 or t=4 columns is equivalent to pairwise mod-two orthogonality of vertex membership patterns p_x∈F₂^t. Patterns of weights one and two are impossible; for t=3 no three-column dependence exists. For t=4 all nonzero patterns must have weight three and each occurs at most once, yielding exactly the three-pattern triangle+edges or four-pattern tetrahedral-faces dependencies. Both forms sum to zero and give binom(m+2,4). Independently enumerated all triples and quadruples for m+1=3,4,5,6: no smaller dependence and exactly 1,5,15,35 minimum supports. The original pinned RESULT.md contains six literal backspace controls in misrendered binomials and a tab in text command; the complete revised RESULT.md and SLOGAN.txt included in this repaired plan remove such source corruption without altering the scientific theorem.
